scope: Blaze Mac live Studio audio controls; public Logic Pro 12.4 listing verified 2026-10-31

reference.screenshot: Current listing Session Players image, original 2880x1800; screenshot filenames predate the current release
reference.scaleNote: Dimensions below are CSS choices based on the published image normalized by 0.5; native points are not independently measured

interaction.pan: Relative horizontal/vertical pointer drag, captured outside the control; actual existing StereoPanner remains authoritative
interaction.range: Native labeled range inputs provide keyboard and accessibility semantics; decorative layers provide the measured control shape
interaction.reset: Option-click or double-click resets pan to center and track volume to unity
interaction.trackGain: Blaze audition gain 0..2; unity at slider unit0.75, display taper -60..+6dB with exact zero at the left stop
interaction.master: Existing media volume 0..1 remains separate and unchanged
interaction.disclosure: Gesture sensitivity and gain taper are Blaze choices, not a claim to Apple's proprietary transfer function or pan-law implementation

contrastNote: Scoped component pairs only; capComposite is the rendered alpha-cap color over the recess, not the literal alpha CSS token. No whole-app accessibility certification.
